title: comfy workflow *
description: Output shape for workflow editing commands (slots, set-slot, vary) and the read-only notes reader.

notes.description: notes: the Note/MarkdownNote documentation nodes the workflow carries, in graph order (top-level nodes first, then each subgraph definition).

id.description: node id as serialized in the workflow

title.description: author-set node title; null when the node uses its default title

text.description: the note body (widgets_values[0]); empty string when the node carries no usable text

pos.description: canvas position, passed through verbatim — litegraph has serialized this as both [x, y] and {"0": x, "1": y}; null when absent

size.description: canvas size, passed through verbatim (same shape caveat as pos); null when absent

subgraph.description: null for a top-level note; {id, name} of the owning subgraph definition otherwise

item_map.description: compose: foreach item -> provenance map. Mirrors the `_meta.items` block embedded in each written workflow (`_meta.schema == "compose/1"`).

nodes.description: node ids this item's branch produced (numerically sorted, includes the save node)

save_node.description: auto-appended save node id, null when the branch is terminal
